rules.name: unsafe fn get_disjoint_unchecked_mut < Q : ? Sized , const N : usize > (& mut self , ks : [& Q ; N] ,) -> [Option < & '_ mut V > ; N] where K : Borrow < Q > , Q : Hash + Eq ,
rules.rule: The keys passed to get_disjoint_unchecked_mut must not overlap, even if the resulting references are not used.
